aws.vpc.network-manager.title: AWS Network Manager (global networks, sites, devices, links, transit gateway registrations)
limitations: The inventory/registration control plane is real (core/networkmanager_core.py): global networks, sites, devices, links, link associations and transit gateway registrations with the real dependency errors; a registered transit gateway must exist in the account's EC2/VPC model and can be registered to one global network only. No topology telemetry, events, route analysis, Connect attachments or Direct Connect/customer-gateway associations.
